name: Appointment Notice
description: Contains a few details about the new commander of Fort Narith. It looks like he was appointed just a few months prior to the Event, and is not from Lamang.

name: Arrest Warrant SH
description: An arrest warrant for Artisan's former colleague.

name: Aulii's Letter
description: This letter contains a heartfelt goodbye and an explanation of the man's actions - he offered himself as a human target in order to provide for his family.

name: Civilian Exposure Analysis
description: Medical records from the Fort Narith infirmary

name: Diary of Habits
description: A diary of one of the villagers from Ban Pa.

name: Doctor's Notes
description: A medical log detailing rapid tissue degradation in two individuals returning from Ground Zero.

name: Dr. Khae's Notes
description: Research notes documenting Dr. Khae's experiments on patients exposed to material recovered from Ground Zero.

name: Embassy Message
description: A profanity-laced letter accusing Russian officials of covert involvement in Lamang.

name: Encrypted Notebook
description: An encrypted notebook with various logins and passwords.

name: Evacuation Restrictions Memorandum
description: A confidential memorandum ordering evacuation restrictions for designated villages.

name: Event - Affected Population
description: Contains information about the medical state of all the people entering the UNLRA refugee camp.

name: Farmer's Diary
description: A diary describing a group of farmers struggling to survive after being left behind during the evacuation.

name: FN Commander Investigation
description: This folder contains details of the exchange, the budget and the goods being traded. Somebody gained a lot of money from this deal, and the LAF got barely functional training jets.

name: Folder 00616
description: A personal folder numbered 00616 on Nuon Bintang. Apparently, he was Fort Narith's former commander and was dishonorably discharged for a multitude of very shady deals.

name: Friend's Letter
description: A strange letter full of suspicious passages.

name: Friend's Letter
description: A strange letter with suspicious text.

name: Gangmembers's Notes
description: A missing parts list for marine repairs, accompanied by frantic remarks about fuel shortages and incoming threats.

name: Grumbling Note
description: A note detailing preparations for the Midnight Sapphire operation, mentioning supply shortages, a contact in Hanoi, and growing pressure from new armed groups.

name: Interrogation Pr 23
description: This folder contains information about prisoner 23. He was processed here and transported to an unknown location.

name: Interrogation SH
description: A transcript of the local mechanic's interrogation.

name: LAF CBRN Report
description: An LAF situation report documenting the Phousai Village incident.

name: LAF Codebook
description: A classified document outlining coded communication protocols for an ongoing operation.

name: Logbook
description: Contains information about the past activities of the group formerly residing in Ban Pa.

name: Lost Tourist's Diary
description: Contains details on the tourist's plans and confirms her identity. She met some guys who like to party and got invited to their "special place." No more entries after that...

name: Medical Analysis
description: A medical analysis documenting the biological changes observed in patients exposed to material recovered from Ground Zero.

name: Nam's Folder
description: A message denying reinforcements and urging someone named “Nam” to secure Midnight Sapphire quickly.

name: New FN Commander's Report
description: A file containing a suspicious report written by the current commander of Fort Narith.

name: Procurement Memo
description: An internal procurement memo outlining procedures for selecting, processing, and transferring “assets.”

name: Prohibited Evacuation
description: Contains orders to prohibit the majority of civilians living near Fort Narith from evacuating. The reasoning for that is unknown.

name: Rebel Chat
description: LLA plans that describe further expansion of their influence after sucessfully capturing YBL-1.

name: Rebel Notebook
description: Plans describing an attack of the Lamang Liberation Army on YBL-1.

name: Research Notes
description: A research log analyzing a mysterious astronomical signal.

name: Sayavong's Escape Plan
description: An urgent message from Narith instructing Jan Park to secure the villa with trusted men.

name: Shaman's Diary
description: A personal confession from “Sad sada,” revealing doubt, internal division, and a growing belief that the Event was a divine warning.

name: Unknown Combatant
description: Contains orders to interrogate an unknown PMC-affiliated prisoner. At the end, the folder contains information that the prisoner has escaped, and an order for recapture was suprisingly not given.

name: UNLRA LAF Deal
description: Orders regarding the transfers of certain individuals from the Tiger Bay refugee camp back into the hands of the LAF.

name: UNLRA Selective Evac
description: This document contains information about certain people who are not permitted to leave the island under any circumstances.

name: VIP Client List
description: This list contains the names of guests enrolled in the VIP program.
